social: Apps, games, and curious little tools. Come in, have a look around, and find something unexpected.

welcome: Welcome. I make apps, games, and little tools.
welcome_more: Some useful. Some playful. All here for you to explore.
bench: A few things from the workshop
planet_alt: Earth with orbital paths in Pale Blue Dot
planet_caption: A whole world in your pocket
art_alt: A portrait formed from radiating cut-metal patterns
kerf_alt: A portrait built from connected metal slats
kerf_feature: What if a photograph could become a piece of cut metal? Patterns, portraits, and art that holds together.
earth_alt: A live globe with orbital paths in Pale Blue Dot
earth_feature: A living, spinning Earth in your pocket. Step back and explore our small place in a very big universe.
bitey_alt: Bitey private food log with its friendly dinosaur companion
bitey_feature: A photo, a portion, a little more understanding of what you eat. And a friendly dinosaur along for the ride.
interlude: A useful tool. A strange idea. A rabbit hole worth following.
collection_intro: There’s no particular order to curiosity.
kerf_card: Turn a photograph into connected patterns ready to cut from metal.
earth_card: A little planet in your pocket. Explore Earth with live astronomy and NASA data.
bitey_card: Photograph a meal, adjust the portion, and keep a food log with a little help from Bitey.
faceslice_card: One photo becomes a 3D relief, sliced into layers for a metal portrait.
garden_card: Bend gravity and grow a garden in a quiet, physics-powered puzzle game.
magpie_card: A place for stray thoughts, photos, and voice notes before they fly away.
sankey_card: Make a picture of where things flow. Build and export diagrams in your browser.
miscare_card: Find a little movement for today, using the equipment you already have.
warp_card: Thread your way through gravity wells in a retro physics arcade game.
omaha_card: Look beneath the stock price and explore what makes a business tick.
spend_card: Give big family expenses a plan, from the first estimate to the last installment.
orbit_card: Put your intuition for gravity to the test with orbital physics puzzles.
trains_card: Keep an eye on Romanian trains, their routes, and changing delays.
thermostat_card: See how warm things are at home, with sensor history and temperature charts.
tdg_card: A tower defense twist: use orbital physics and rescue beams to save, rather than destroy.
olx_card: Follow marketplace finds, compare price changes, and catch a promising deal.
bp_card: Log blood pressure readings, explore trends, and export your history. One app for Android and the web.
admitere_card: Explore admission history and simulate high school choices in Bucharest.
pwakit_card: The little building block that helps web apps work offline and stay up to date.
invite_card: One small console for managing invitations and devices across private web apps.

about_text: I’m the maker behind Zandaulion. This is my little workshop on the web: a collection of apps, games, and tools that stretches from everyday routines to art and orbital physics.
about_more: Have a wander, try something out, or take a peek at the code. If something catches your imagination, I’d love to hear about it.
translation_note: Project pages are available in all 12 languages. Privacy notices remain in English at their existing URLs.
